title: Veldis
description: A community adventure : Dive into a 12-year-old server filled with history, creativity, and endless possibilities!
body:
# 🌲 A Vanilla Server Built to Last

A **vanilla Minecraft community** with over 12 years of uninterrupted history. No resets. No gimmicks. Just a persistent world, a warm community, and a place worth coming back to.


## ✨ Why join?

- **Pure vanilla** — no unnecessary plugins or alterations
- **11+ years of history** — a living world shaped by real players since 2014
- **Chill atmosphere** — no pressure, no PvP grief, no toxicity
- **Friendly community** — primarily francophone, always welcoming
- **Stable and reliable** — we've outlasted dozens of servers and we're not stopping


## 🛠️ Datapacks & quality of life

We use a small set of carefully chosen datapacks that respect the vanilla spirit while smoothing out the rough edges. [See the full list →](https://veldis.online/en/datapack)


## 🔗 Join us

**IP:** `play.veldis.online`  
**Version:** 26.1.2
**Platform:** Java
